standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player is a Rookie:

steps.npc: I've not seen you round these parts before.

steps.player: Well I'm still fairly new here.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player is a rank higher than Rookie:

steps.npc: You heard correct.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: The name's Gloria. Nice to meet you.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: You too. I'm [player name]. What are you doing hanging round the Colosseum?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: I've become quite fond of keeping an eye on the contenders and sharing news of their progress to those around the city.
You see, inside the Colosseum you'll earn what's called Glory.
Glory will improve your status and reputation around the city. You might even get some rewards.

steps.npc: It's simple really, you get Glory from participating in the Colosseum! You'll get more Glory the better you perform.
Performance is measured by a few things. For example, how many hits you take or how quickly you complete the challenges.

steps.player: Sounds good to me. Have you earned any Glory yourself?

steps.npc: Ha! No. But I do have this fancy armour which is pretty glorious! You may be lucky enough to get some of your own from within the Colosseum.

steps.player: Tell me more about these rewards.

steps.npc: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.

options.text: Do you know my Glory status?
Tell me more about these rewards.

steps.player: Tell me more about these rewards.

steps.npc: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.
You'll get a range of benefits depending on your status.

steps.player: How do I improve my status?

steps.npc: Earn more Glory of course. The more you earn, the better your standing in the city.
You can check your status on that board over there. I keep it up to date.
Well...
Reaching Brawler status will give you access to the bank within the Colosseum.
Reaching Challenger status will allow you to respawn in Civitas illa Fortis if you so desire.
Reaching Gladiator status might persuade some of the more shady folk around the city to give you more money for... Let's just say illicit valuables.
Reaching Hero status will allow you to travel to the Colosseum via the Ring of Dueling.
Reaching Champion status will grant you free herb patch protection just west of the city.
And reaching Grand Champion status will unlock you the Fortis Salute emote.

steps.player: Do you know how much Glory I need for each status?

steps.npc: You'll have to figure that out on your journey to becoming a Grand Champion.

options.text: Do you know my Glory status?

steps.player: Do you know my Glory status?

steps.npc: That I do, [player name].

steps.text: If the player is a Rookie:

steps.npc: It seems as though you are still a Rookie to the people of Fortis.
You'll make a name of yourself in no time, [player name].

steps.text: If the player is a Brawler:

steps.npc: You are a Brawler!

steps.text: If the player is a Challenger:

steps.npc: You are a Challenger!

steps.text: If the player is a Gladiator:

steps.npc: You are a Gladiator!

steps.text: If the player is a Hero:

steps.npc: You are a Hero!

steps.text: If the player is a Champion:

steps.npc: You are a Champion!

steps.text: If the player is a Grand Champion:

steps.npc: You are a Grand Champion!
You can check that board over there to see any details of your Glory. I try to update it regularly.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player is not a Grand Champion:

steps.npc: I see you've been trying to conquer the Colosseum, eh?

steps.player: I have indeed, and I will become a champion!

steps.npc: That's it, positive thoughts.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player is a Grand Champion:

steps.npc: I was watching when you became Grand Champion of the Colosseum. It was truly something to behold.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: What brings you over to me today?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.player: I was wondering if we could talk about Glory?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: But of course. What do you wish to know?

options.text: Do you know my Glory status?
Can you change my respawn point?
options.condition: If the player is Challenger rank or higher:

steps.player: Can you change my respawn point?

steps.npc: What would you like changing about it?

steps.text: If the player's current respawn point is not Civitas illa Fortis:

steps.player: Do you think you could change my respawn point to Civitas illa Fortis?

steps.npc: I'm sure I could put in a good word at the palace now that you are a [rank].
Anytime, [rank].

steps.player: On second thoughts, I'll leave it for now.

steps.npc: No problem.

steps.text: If the player's current respawn point is Civitas illa Fortis:

steps.player: I was wondering if I could respawn back in Lumbridge instead of the city?

steps.npc: Not a problem. I'll let the palace know right away.
No problem.

steps.player: On second thoughts, I'll leave it for now.

steps.npc: No problem.
